title: Ordinance Section 37.9(a) Just Cause Requirements
requirement: A landlord must have one of 17 specified 'just cause' reasons as the dominant motive to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, or to remove access to certain housing services.
coverage_conditions: rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance
quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
